description: Read-only facts about a PDF: version, pageCount, encryption, pdfA claim (the claim, not its validity — use veraPDF for that), signatureCount, hasSignaturePlaceholder, attachments[], info; presence-gated dss / docTimestampCount / trapped; `signatures:true` lists every field (subFilter, isDocTimestamp, isPlaceholder, byteRange, vriKey); `pages:true` adds per-page sizes and boxes. `check:[…]` turns it into a CI assertion ('pdfa','signed','encrypted','placeholder','attachments','dss','docTimestamp','trapped') → checks (requested keys only) + checksPassed. Encrypted sources: pass `password`. Token-frugal: verbosity:'summary', fields:[…].

annotations.description: When true, include an annotations[] array listing every page annotation (/Annots: links, text notes, highlights, shapes, widgets…) with its 0-based page, subtype, rect and, when present, contents (truncated to 200 chars), title, color, quadPoints and link url. Off by default to keep responses compact.

check.description: CI assertions → checks (requested keys only) + checksPassed (all hold). 'signed' = a signature field with signed content exists (structural; validity is verify_pdf's job), 'placeholder' = an unsigned placeholder exists, 'dss' = /DSS present, 'docTimestamp' = a /DocTimeStamp exists, 'trapped' = /Info /Trapped set, 'annotations' = at least one page annotation exists, 'pdfx' = the XMP claims PDF/X (the claim, not its validity — validate_pdf standard:'pdf-x-4').

fields.description: Optional dot-path projection applied to the structured result (e.g. ['pageCount','signatureCount']). Composes after verbosity. Unknown paths are omitted.

pages.description: When true, include per-page metadata in the response.

password.description: Password (user or owner) of an encrypted source. Never logged or echoed.

signatures.description: When true, include a signatures[] array describing every signature field (field name, SubFilter, document-timestamp flag, placeholder flag, ByteRange, /Contents length, /VRI key). Off by default to keep responses compact.

verbosity.description: 'full' (default) or 'summary' (scalars only: version, pageCount, encryption, pdfA, signatureCount, hasSignaturePlaceholder, attachmentCount, + docTimestampCount / trapped / pdfX / checksPassed when present; arrays and dss dropped).

name: inspect_pdf

outputSchema.description: Structured inspection result. Every property is optional because the result can be projected: verbosity:'summary' returns only the scalar summary fields, fields:[...] keeps a dot-path subset. Defaults return the full shape.

annotationCount.description: Total number of page annotations (opt-in via the `annotations` input).

annotations.description: Page annotations (opt-in via the `annotations` input), in page order then /Annots order. Only the keys the annotation actually carries are emitted.

rect.description: /Rect [x1, y1, x2, y2] in PDF user space; absent when malformed.

subtype.description: /Subtype, e.g. Link, Text, Highlight, Square, FreeText, Widget.

url.description: Target of a URI-action link annotation.

attachmentCount.description: summary only: number of embedded files.

checks.description: One boolean per REQUESTED check (keys = the check[] you passed, nothing else).

checksPassed.description: Present when check[] was supplied: true when every requested check holds.

docTimestampCount.description: Number of /DocTimeStamp signature fields, present only when at least one exists.

dss.description: Document Security Store summary (ISO 32000-2 §12.8.4.3), present only when the catalog has a /DSS.

vriKeys.description: /VRI dictionary keys (uppercase-hex SHA-1 of each covered signature /Contents).

encryptionInfo.description: Precise Standard Security Handler details (pdfnative v1.6.0), present only when the document is encrypted and was opened successfully. Objects served by the reader are already decrypted.

authenticatedAs.description: Which supplied password opened the document.

hasSignaturePlaceholder.description: True when at least one signature widget exists with empty /Contents — i.e. an unsigned placeholder awaiting `sign_pdf`.

info.description: Document /Info dictionary entries decoded as strings.

pageLabels.description: Logical page-numbering ranges from the /PageLabels number tree (ISO 32000-1 §12.4.2), or absent when the document has none. Each range gives the 0-based first page, numbering style, optional prefix and start value.

pdfA.description: Detected PDF/A claim (e.g. '1B', '2B', '2U', '3B') from XMP metadata, or null when absent.

pdfX.description: PDF/X claim from XMP (pdfxid:GTS_PDFXVersion, e.g. 'PDF/X-4'), present only when the document makes one. A claim, not a verdict: validate_pdf standard:'pdf-x-4' checks it.

artBox.description: /ArtBox, present only when set on the page.

bleedBox.description: /BleedBox, present only when set on the page.

cropBox.description: /CropBox, present only when set on the page.

trimBox.description: /TrimBox [llx lly urx ury], present only when set on the page.

userUnit.description: /UserUnit (PDF 1.6+), present only when set on the page.

signatures.description: Signature fields (opt-in via the `signatures` input). Document timestamps are listed inline with isDocTimestamp=true.

contentsLength.description: Decoded /Contents length in bytes (including zero padding).

isPlaceholder.description: True for an unsigned placeholder (all-zero /ByteRange or /Contents).

vriKey.description: Uppercase-hex SHA-1 of /Contents — the /DSS /VRI key. Null for placeholders.

trapped.description: /Info /Trapped flag, present only when the document carries one.

title: Inspect PDF metadata
